sentences.en: I got out of bed and had a good stretch.
Ha-ha, you always stretch when class is over don't you?
sentences.zh: 哈哈，你每次下课后不都是这样伸展吗？

sentences.en: During the intermission I got up to stretch my legs.
sentences.zh: 中场休息时我去活动了一下筋骨。
